about: The Illinois Hammer Injury Law Firm Dworkin and Maciariello is a personal injury firm with a single office in Chicago.

The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free; it will visit clients in hospital or at home. It publishes material in English and Spanish.
